title: Tasks
description: The machine-readable task list a plan produces, at docs/<date>/<slug>/<version>/tasks-<date>.json. TASKS prose stays the file a person reads; this is the file a verifier reads.

date.description: Calendar day of this revision. Must match the path date segment and the dated basename.

version.description: Global revision number for the slug.

tasks.description: An empty list would end a run rather than describe one, so it is refused.

id.description: Unique within the file. Matches the heading in TASKS prose.

status.description: Five states, not more. 'ready' and 'awaiting_user' are derivable from dependencies and run state, and a status nothing reads goes stale. Only done and canceled settle a task: a blocked task is still in scope.

branch.description: The delivery branch for this task. One task, one branch, one PR.

dependsOn.description: Task ids that must settle first. Every id must exist in this file.

acceptance.description: What makes this task done, in one line. The detail lives in TASKS prose.

note.description: Why a task is blocked or canceled, when the status alone does not say.
